verdict.rationale: Orama's own materials describe it as a search library that adds 'fast, relevant search' and can be imported directly in a browser module, so in-app client-side search is supported. Nothing documents millisecond latency or as-you-type, per-keystroke updating. missing for 10: documented millisecond-level latency figures or benchmarks, explicit as-you-type/search-on-keystroke guidance or examples, independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke

citations.quote: Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
Or import it directly in a browser module
